scenes.text: A recorder was left running in an empty room overnight.
The tape held nine hours of silence.
Then, at 4:07, a calm voice said one sentence.
It named the investigator who would later take the case.
That investigator was eleven years old at the time.
Follow Unsolved Archive for the next file.
